title: H.I.V. Research Networks May Again Seek Federal Funding, With a Twist
summary: The Trump administration restarted the process for funding four large research networks after postponing it earlier this year.

title: CVS Health’s Planned Breakup Hasn’t Quieted Antitrust Critics
summary: Lawmakers are warning that spinning off the health care conglomerate’s drugstores will not end scrutiny over its power.
caption: CVS has grown over the past two decades to encompass a vast array of health care businesses.

title: Measles Is a Growing Risk for Adults in the United States
summary: The danger is greatest for those who are unvaccinated, but vaccinated people born before 1989 may no longer be sufficiently protected, medical experts said.
caption: Rita, who asked to be identified by her first name to protect her privacy, was treated for measles in March, despite having been vaccinated when she was a child.
